scope: Durable compaction progress, explicit failure, cancellable transport recovery

layers: Core SummaryRunner and existing retry policy
implementation.percentage: Not reported: recursive splitting discovers additional work dynamically
implementation.progressPayload: Numeric snapshots only; no partial summary text or reasoning
implementation.delivery: Bounded channel of four snapshots; journaled at work boundaries, not on every stream chunk
implementation.historyIndex: Version 3; start and latest progress only, plus committed summary where needed; rebuilt from authoritative journal
implementation.commit: Existing atomic summary/checkpoint/end transaction, only after candidate budget validation
implementation.recovery: Classified transient transport failures reuse sustained backoff when enabled; HTTP and unstructured failures remain bounded; credential errors stop
implementation.controls: Existing pause/resume/cancel/steer are processed during summarization; resume preserves remaining retry time
implementation.failure: Visible terminal card and error details; unsuccessful candidate never replaces original model history
implementation.presentation: Single bilingual status: Compacting context… · May take a few minutes / 正在压缩… · 可能需要几分钟. No progress bar, percentage, request/retry count, stage expansion or ticking clock. Paused and terminal errors remain explicit; failure details can be expanded.
